items: A run whose worker delivered a result waits in Needs decision instead of failing when review findings remain or a completion step is refused
Cancel always frees its slot unless another active run owns it, and cancel, settlement and slot release stop a browser session the run left behind
A relaunched worker no longer shows its failed predecessor's error, and a native reviewer no longer waits on an approval nobody can see
A chunked file transfer survives a node restart, and a request on a closed node connection fails at once
WebP evidence stills are packaged, published in PR bodies and given to reviewers like PNG stills
